changelog:
Initial release of the Children’s Picture Book Generator skill.

- Generates illustrated images for children’s stories using Baidu ERNIE-Image-Turbo via an OpenAI-compatible API.
- Supports 7 preset resolutions and explicit command-line parameters for image customization.
- Allows API key configuration via both environment variables and command-line arguments.
- Utilizes the OpenAI Python SDK for seamless integration with Baidu’s image generation service.
- Designed for cross-platform compatibility (Windows/macOS/Linux) and easy, single-command operation.
